Subject: [opensuse] mdadm does not seem to set internal bitmap correctly

Hi All,

    I have 3 soft-raid devices as show:

    md0 : active raid1 sda1[0] sdc1[2] sdb1[1]
              136508 blocks super 1.0 [3/3] [UUU]
              bitmap: 0/9 pages [0KB], 8KB chunk

    md1 : active raid5 sda2[0] sdc2[3] sdb2[1]
              1060096 blocks super 1.0 level 5, 128k chunk, algorithm 2 
[3/3] [UUU]

    md2 : active raid5 sda3[0] sdc3[3] sdb3[1]
              780083968 blocks super 1.0 level 5, 128k chunk, algorithm 
2 [3/3] [UUU]

    So far so good. When I try add an internal bitmap to /dev/md2, it 
does not seem right. eg.:

    mdadm -Gb internal /dev/md2

    and the result is:

    md2 : active raid5 sda3[0] sdc3[3] sdb3[1]
              780083968 blocks super 1.0 level 5, 128k chunk, algorithm 
2 [3/3] [UUU]
              bitmap: 6/6 pages [24KB], 32768KB chunk

    Problem: Just 6 pages with a 32MB chunk? is this normal ?

    The strangest thing is that when this system was being built for the 
first time with openSUSE 10.3 install DVD, is seemed ok. But I had to 
cancel the synchronizing on md2 for other problems.

    How can I get my bitmap to have more than 6 pages ? Or I misjudging 
all this ?

Thanks for your help,

   

-- 
Rui Santos
http://www.ruisantos.com/

Veni, vidi, Linux!
